desc: A crash inside the graphics driver while Direct3D 12 starts (TTYD_CRASH_TEST=gpu_start, right after gpu_start.txt names it; port/include/port/gpu_start.h): the record is left on storage with starting=d3d12, the crash report says which graphics API was starting, and the process ends with PORT_EXIT_GPU_START (0x00475055) so Paper Cut.exe starts the game again; gpu_start_crash_next is that next start

user/crash_report.txt: ^while starting the graphics API: Direct3D 12 \(the next start passes it over\)
